title: Collatz sequence on one line
prompt: Print the Collatz sequence that starts at 6 on a single line, with the numbers separated by ` -> ` (space, hyphen, greater-than sign, space), ending with 1. The rule is: if n is even replace it with n / 2, otherwise replace it with 3n + 1. The line begins `6 -> 3 -> 10`.
